title: chore(deps): resolve npm security advisories
author: Kielek
body:
# Changes

Updates npm dependency locks and targeted npm overrides for the repository root, frontend, payment, and React Native app dependency trees.

The changes resolve the npm advisories identified during security triage by updating vulnerable transitive packages including affected `brace-expansion`, `picomatch`, `postcss`, `protobufjs`, `uuid`, `lodash`, `flatted`, `@xmldom/xmldom`, and related dependency paths.

Verification completed:

* `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` in the repository root: `found 0 vulnerabilities`
* `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` in `src/frontend`: `found 0 vulnerabilities`
* `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` in `src/payment`: `found 0 vulnerabilities`
* `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` in `src/react-native-app`: `found 0 vulnerabilities`
